title: Gold at a 20-day high in euros but not in dollars
system: Stand-alone gold rule (XAU/USD), signal from XAU/EUR; not the live gold book

rule.signal: XAU/EUR close beyond its 20-day closing extreme while XAU/USD's is not: long (high) / short (low)
rule.stop: k x ATR(20) before the entry
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: both sides, hold 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20) (primary)
long signals only, hold 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20)
both sides, hold 10 candles, stop 3 x ATR(20)

headline: FAIL, 0 of 3: buying (selling) gold after a 20-day high (low) in euros but not in dollars makes +0.103R a trade net out of sample 2017-26 (n 121, month t +1.38); it beats 39 of 40 placebos.
